across_seed.method: two-sided 95% t-interval on the seed means (t = mean of per-seed deltas, SE = sample SD over seeds / sqrt(n_seeds))

pooled.method: percentile of the pooled donor-stratified paired replicates: the per-seed replicate arrays are concatenated and the 2.5th/97.5th percentiles taken once over the union

pooled.bound_convention: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the pooled replicate distribution
